rule: D starts empty. For every item in v2new.remove and 1108.remove, add its id to D. For every item in v2new.fix_key and 1108.fix_key: if verdict is BAD_KEY, add its id to D; if verdict is KEY_FORMAT, grade that item's own new_key against the pool answer with grade_answer(gold, problem, '<think>x</think> \\boxed{' + new_key + '}', False) and add its id to D if code is not P. An id is dropped if ANY of its items says drop. kept_key_format is the ids of KEY_FORMAT items whose grade was P, minus D. There is no precedence between audits. No task is re-keyed.
